bs.protection.standardDescription: Filtriranje na nivou DNS-a. Zaustavlja oko 64% poznatih domena za reklame i praćenje. Certifikat nije potreban.
bs.protection.fullDescription: DNS filtriranje uz pregled web saobraćaja. Zaustavlja 70–85% zahtjeva za reklame i praćenje. Traži instaliran zaštitni profil.
bs.protection.coverageNote: Nijedan nivo ne zaustavlja sve. Aplikacije koje zaobilaze sistemski pregled, QUIC/HTTP3 saobraćaj i servisi sa ugrađenim certifikatom uvijek propuste dio. Navedene brojke su iz mjerenja, ne obećanje.
bs.protection.androidNote: Na novijim Android verzijama certifikat važi za internet preglednik, dok pojedine aplikacije nastavljaju sa standardnom zaštitom.
bs.protection.androidFirefoxNote: Firefox na Androidu drži vlastitu listu certifikata i ne koristi sistemsku. Ako ga koristite, certifikat morate dodati i u sam Firefox — u suprotnom on ostaje bez pune zaštite.
bs.protection.iosNote: Korak sa postavkama pouzdanosti je obavezan. Bez njega iPhone neće koristiti punu zaštitu.
bs.protection.windowsNote: Chrome i Edge koriste sistemsku listu certifikata, pa im je ovo dovoljno. Firefox drži vlastitu listu i treba ga dodati zasebno, u njegovim postavkama.
bs.protection.macNote: Safari i Chrome koriste sistemski keychain. Firefox drži vlastitu listu i treba ga dodati zasebno, u njegovim postavkama.
bs.protection.pinningNote: Pojedine aplikacije, poput bankovnih, namjerno odbijaju ovakvu zaštitu. Za njih ostaje standardna zaštita — to je očekivano i nije greška.
bs.protection.androidStep1: Na uređaju koji štitite otvorite ovu stranicu i preuzmite Fornect certifikat.
bs.protection.androidStep2: Otvorite Postavke, pa Sigurnost i privatnost.
bs.protection.androidStep3: Pronađite stavku za instalaciju certifikata i izaberite preuzeti fajl.
bs.protection.androidStep4: Potvrdite naziv Fornect i, ako telefon zatraži, unesite PIN ili otisak prsta.
bs.protection.iosStep1: Na uređaju koji štitite otvorite ovu stranicu i preuzmite Fornect profil.
bs.protection.iosStep2: Otvorite Postavke — na vrhu će se pojaviti stavka Preuzeti profil.
bs.protection.iosStep3: Dodirnite Instaliraj i unesite kod uređaja.
bs.protection.iosStep4: Otvorite Postavke, pa Općenito, Info, i uključite Fornect u postavkama pouzdanosti certifikata.
bs.protection.windowsStep2: Dvoklik na preuzeti fajl, pa izaberite „Install Certificate".
bs.protection.windowsStep3: Izaberite „Local Machine" i potvrdite upit sistema za dozvolu.
bs.protection.windowsStep4: Izaberite „Place all certificates in the following store", odaberite „Trusted Root Certification Authorities" i potvrdite.
bs.protection.macStep2: Dvoklik na preuzeti fajl — otvara se Keychain Access (Pristup ključevima).
bs.protection.macStep3: Izaberite keychain „System" i unesite administratorsku lozinku.
bs.protection.macStep4: Nađite Fornect u listi, dvoklik na njega, otvorite odjeljak „Trust" i postavite „When using this certificate" na „Always Trust".

en.protection.standardDescription: Filtering at the DNS level. Stops around 64% of known advertising and tracking domains. No certificate needed.
en.protection.fullDescription: DNS filtering plus inspection of web traffic. Stops 70–85% of advertising and tracking requests. Requires the installed protection profile.
en.protection.coverageNote: No level stops everything. Apps that bypass system inspection, QUIC/HTTP3 traffic and services with pinned certificates always let some through. The figures above come from measurements, not a promise.
en.protection.androidNote: On newer Android versions the certificate applies to the web browser, while some apps continue with standard protection.
en.protection.androidFirefoxNote: Firefox on Android keeps its own certificate list and does not use the system one. If you use it, the certificate must also be added inside Firefox — otherwise it stays without full protection.
en.protection.iosNote: The trust settings step is required. Without it the iPhone will not use full protection.
en.protection.windowsNote: Chrome and Edge use the system certificate list, so this is enough for them. Firefox keeps its own list and has to be handled separately, in its settings.
en.protection.macNote: Safari and Chrome use the system keychain. Firefox keeps its own list and has to be handled separately, in its settings.
en.protection.pinningNote: Some apps, such as banking apps, deliberately refuse this kind of protection. They keep standard protection - this is expected and not an error.
en.protection.androidStep1: On the device you are protecting, open this page and download the Fornect certificate.
en.protection.androidStep2: Open Settings, then Security and privacy.
en.protection.androidStep3: Find the option to install a certificate and choose the downloaded file.
en.protection.androidStep4: Confirm the name Fornect and, if the phone asks, enter your PIN or fingerprint.
en.protection.iosStep1: On the device you are protecting, open this page and download the Fornect profile.
en.protection.iosStep2: Open Settings - a Downloaded Profile entry appears at the top.
en.protection.iosStep3: Tap Install and enter your device passcode.
en.protection.iosStep4: Open Settings, then General, About, and turn on Fornect under certificate trust settings.
en.protection.windowsStep1: Download the Fornect certificate to your computer.
en.protection.windowsStep2: Double-click the downloaded file, then choose “Install Certificate”.
en.protection.windowsStep3: Choose “Local Machine” and approve the system prompt.
en.protection.windowsStep4: Choose “Place all certificates in the following store”, select “Trusted Root Certification Authorities” and confirm.
en.protection.macStep1: Download the Fornect certificate to your Mac.
en.protection.macStep2: Double-click the downloaded file — Keychain Access opens.
en.protection.macStep3: Choose the “System” keychain and enter your administrator password.
en.protection.macStep4: Find Fornect in the list, double-click it, open the “Trust” section and set “When using this certificate” to “Always Trust”.
